observations.text: Log walk 2-3 Nov: errors cluster in the 13:50, 21:06 and 07:01 UTC rollouts: about 900 missing-column errors in 4 minutes on 3 Nov, 2,200 connect timeouts and 190 lock timeouts on 2 Nov. Sentry: 7 server issues, 12 events. One scheduled report failed to post.
4 Nov: no successful rollout since v0.1.142 at 00:39 UTC, so the fix cannot be checked yet. Lock timeouts outside rollouts moved to db-lock-contention.

fixes.text: Keep agent calls working through database schema rollouts (#3419), merged 4 Nov, not yet released

title: Each production rollout breaks agent calls for several minutes
whatHappens: During each deploy, agents cannot list corners or fetch commands for minutes: missing-column errors, database connect timeouts and lock timeouts. Posts can fail.
